# Legacy Project Vehicles

These GLB files were migrated from the original OBLITERATUSAI project:

- `lowpoly-cars.glb`
- `drivable-sedan.glb`
- `truck.glb`

The Unity port currently uses `car9` from `lowpoly-cars.glb` for the prototype drivable car and parked-car visuals. Original external provenance was not documented in the old repository, so these files remain prototype-only pending a final shipping-asset review.
